shorts_extract.hook: Playing a patient's own mathematical CA3-to-CA1 spike code back into their hippocampus boosted human memory by 37% on the spot.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Hampson, Song, Deadwyler & Berger (2018): 17 epilepsy patients, microwires in CA3/CA1, nonlinear MIMO Volterra model, +37% short-term & +35% 75-min recall vs 0% scrambled control.
shorts_extract.twist: The chip never knew what image the patient saw — it acted purely as a synaptic translator speaking native millisecond rhythm.
